devices.title: Connected devices
devices.intro: The browsers this account is signed in on. End a session you do not recognise, or one left open on a shared computer: that browser is asked to sign in again.
devices.end_others: Sign out of all the others
devices.failed: The session could not be ended.
devices.unreachable: The list of devices could not be read.
devices.end_others_title: Sign out of all the other devices?
devices.end_others_message: Every session of this account ends but this one: those devices will have to sign in again. If someone else is using this account, change its password too: only that keeps them out.

password.title: Password
password.intro: A new password signs you out of all your devices, this one included.
password.changed: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.

problems.current_password: The current password is not the right one.
problems.too_short: The new password must be at least {{min}} characters long.
problems.unchanged: Choose a password different from the current one.
problems.breached: This password appears in a data breach: choose another.
problems.mismatch: The two entries of the new password differ.
problems.too_many: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
problems.network: The server is not answering. Try again.
problems.refused: The password could not be changed.

account.scan_feedback: Beep and buzz each time the camera reads a code

scanner.title: My scanner
scanner.gap: A character must follow the one before within {{ms}} ms to be taken for a scan.
scanner.test: Test my scanner: scan a code here
scanner.result: Your scanner types a character every few milliseconds; suggested setting: {{ms}} ms.
scanner.nothing: Nothing was read: these are keys typed by hand, or too few characters.

account.company_at_sign_in_off: Otherwise, the company used last opens.
account.pin_failed: The company at sign-in could not be saved: nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
account.shortcuts_intro: One key, without Ctrl or Alt, for each action. It does nothing while you type in a field. Ctrl K always opens the search.

shortcut_refused.length: A single key: a letter or a sign.
shortcut_refused.browser: The browser already uses this key.
shortcut_refused.interface: This key already works everywhere (“?” and “[”).
shortcut_refused.screen: A page already uses this key (S, V, L, P or F).
shortcut_refused.count: Kept for the count typed before a scan (digits and ×).

notifications.title: Bell and e-mails
notifications.intro: For each company, and for what is about your account, choose what the bell counts and what is also sent to you by e-mail. A muted notification stays in the list without being counted.
notifications.failed: The choice could not be saved.
notifications.unreachable: The notifications could not be read.

deletion.title: Delete my account
deletion.intro: Your account is closed at once, on all your devices, then deleted for good after a few days. Signing in before then cancels the deletion. Documents stay with the companies that issued them.
deletion.confirm_message: All your sessions end now. An email gives you the day the deletion becomes final: until then, signing in takes it back.
deletion.step_up: To delete your account, enter your password or use a passkey.
deletion.done: Account closed. It will be deleted for good on {{day}}, unless you sign in before then.
deletion.failed: The account could not be deleted. Try again.
deletion.operator: A platform operator's account is not deleted from here: another operator can deactivate it.
deletion.sole_owner: You are the only owner of these companies: give ownership to another member, or close the company, then try again.
